recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-14771 unless the PA work group explicitly wants a purely editorial relocation of existing guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-14771 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for FHIR-core-PractitionerRole asking how to associate repeated location, healthcareService, and availability values. The resolution said to add guidance explaining that if availability differs for a location, a separate PractitionerRole instance should be created.
initial_application: Legacy commit a0a7a69e0dae891e23be5069769cb1d50f7a8ae5, titled 'GF#14771 clarified guidance', applied the issue by adding a brief PractitionerRole Scope and Usage sentence and a longer multiple-location note. No commit using the later FHIR-14771 key was found, but the GF#14771 commit matches the Jira issue and requested guidance.
additional_context: PractitionerRole is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/practitionerrole/practitionerrole-introduction.xml still says separate PractitionerRole instances should be created when availability, telecom, or other details differ across healthcareservices or locations, and source/practitionerrole/practitionerrole-notes.xml explains that all details apply to all locations in a multi-location PractitionerRole. Later R5/R6 refactoring changed PractitionerRole.availability to a singular Availability datatype, but did not change the relationship guidance. The linked Zulip thread aligns with the Jira decision, and Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current build-scoped PractitionerRole source already conveys the requested rule, and duplicating it in another section would be redundant.
